problem: Return the largest number in a list.
buggyCode: function largest(values) { let max = 0; for (const value of values) { if (value > max) { max = value; } } return max; }
rootCause: Initialize the accumulator to the first element or negative infinity instead of zero.

problem: Return the sum of all numbers from 1 to n inclusive.
buggyCode: function sumToN(n) { let total = 0; for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) { total += i; } return total; }
rootCause: Include the final value by looping to n inclusive instead of stopping before n.

problem: Return the list with negative numbers removed.
buggyCode: function removeNegatives(values) { for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { if (values[i] < 0) { values.splice(i, 1); } } return values; }
rootCause: Removing an element shifts the next one into the current index, so it is skipped; build a new list instead of splicing the one being iterated.

problem: Return the average of two integers as a number.
buggyCode: function average(a, b) { return Math.floor((a + b) / 2); }
rootCause: Do not floor the division before returning the average.

problem: Return the first even number in the list, or null if none exist.
buggyCode: function firstEven(values) { for (const value of values) { if (value % 2 === 0) { return value; } return null; } return null; }
rootCause: Return null only after the loop completes; do not exit the loop before checking all values.

problem: Return true only when the number is positive.
buggyCode: function isPositive(value) { return value >= 0; }
rootCause: Use a strict comparison to detect positivity instead of allowing zero.

problem: Return the factorial of n.
buggyCode: function factorial(n) { return n * factorial(n - 1); }
actual: RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded
rootCause: Add a base case for n = 0 or n = 1 before recursing.

problem: Return true when the numeric value is greater than 10.
buggyCode: function isGreaterThanTen(value) { return String(value) > "10"; }
rootCause: Compare the numbers themselves; string comparison orders character by character, so '9' sorts after '10'.

problem: Return the index of the first value equal to 7.
buggyCode: function firstIndexOfSeven(values) { for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { if (values[i] === i) { return i; } } return -1; }
rootCause: Compare the current element to 7 instead of comparing the element's index value.

problem: Return the minimum number in a list.
buggyCode: function minimum(values) { let min = 0; for (const value of values) { if (value < min) { min = value; } } return min; }
rootCause: Initialize the accumulator to the first element or a very large value instead of zero.

problem: Return the median of a list of numbers.
buggyCode: function median(values) { const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b); return sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length / 2)]; }
rootCause: For an even count the median is the mean of the two middle values, not the upper one alone.

problem: Return the first non-zero value in a list, or null if none exist.
buggyCode: function firstNonZero(values) { let result = 0; for (const value of values) { if (value !== 0) { return value; } } return result; }
rootCause: Use a sentinel that can represent 'not found' and return it only after the loop ends.

problem: Return true when the string ends with the suffix 'ing'.
buggyCode: function endsWithIng(text) { return text.startsWith('ing'); }
rootCause: Check the suffix, not the prefix.

problem: Return true only when the number is even.
buggyCode: function isEven(value) { return value % 2 === 1; }
rootCause: Check for a remainder of zero rather than one.

problem: Return true when any value repeats in the list.
buggyCode: function hasDuplicate(values) { for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { for (let j = i + 1; j < values.length; j++) { if (values[i] !== values[j]) { return true; } } } return false; }
rootCause: The duplicate test should only return true when two values are equal.

problem: Return the second largest number in a list.
buggyCode: function secondLargest(values) { let largest = values[0]; let second = values[0]; for (const value of values) { if (value > largest) { second = largest; largest = value; } } return second; }
rootCause: A value below the maximum but above the current second-largest must also update the second-largest, not only a new maximum.

problem: Return true when the string reads the same forwards and backwards.
buggyCode: function isPalindrome(text) { for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) { if (text[i] !== text[text.length - i]) { return false; } } return true; }
rootCause: The mirror of index i is length - 1 - i, not length - i.

problem: Return the last index of a value in the list.
buggyCode: function lastIndex(values, target) { let index = -1; for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { if (values[i] === target) { index = i + 1; } } return index; }
rootCause: Store the actual index of the match rather than incrementing it by one.

problem: Return the average of the values in the list.
buggyCode: function averageList(values) { let total = 0; for (const value of values) { total += value; } return total / (values.length - 1); }
rootCause: Divide by the number of items, not by the count minus one.

problem: Return true when every value is zero.
buggyCode: function allZeros(values) { for (const value of values) { if (value === 0) { return true; } } return false; }
rootCause: One zero does not prove all are zero; return false on the first non-zero value and true only after the loop ends.
